about_the_game:
MiniEco is a cozy, top-down nature simulation blending laid-back idle/clicker gameplay with hands-on ecosystem nurturing and a hint of god-like power. Dive into a vibrant, living world and watch ecosystems evolve before your eyes.

✨ Features

  • Dynamic World Generation: Experience expansive landscapes featuring diverse terrains, teeming oceans, and thousands of unique organisms that interact in real-time.

  • Evolving Ecosystems: Every creature carries genetic code that mutates naturally, enabling fascinating evolutionary pathways and the emergence of entirely new species.

  • Combat & Survival Dynamics: Influence ecosystems toward harmony or chaos—creatures may peacefully coexist, fiercely compete, or flee from danger, shaping their habitats accordingly.

  • Resource & Currency Management: Harness Atoms and Energy to spawn life, intervene in ecosystems, and gather collectible items from creatures to unlock and upgrade your god-like powers.

📅 Planned Features

  • Expanded Simulations: New biomes, richer AI behaviors, and deeper interactions among species.

  • Gameplay Upgrades: Advanced predator-prey dynamics, refined genetic systems, and enhanced resource management mechanics.

  • Statistical Insights & Control: Detailed tracking tools for monitoring species populations, genetic traits, as well as flexible options for saving/loading progress.

  • Performance Optimization: Improved graphics, intuitive controls, and overall stability to support increasingly complex, dynamic worlds.

🌟 Your Voice Matters: MiniEco evolves with you! Your insights, suggestions, and ideas are key to shaping the future of this cozy nature sim.
